facts.text_en: Madonna's official site notes that Prince played uncredited guitar on this track.
facts.text_fr: Le site officiel de Madonna précise que Prince a joué de la guitare sur ce titre sans être crédité.
facts.source_title: Like A Prayer – The Silver Collection Vinyl
facts.evidence: The official Madonna page names Like A Prayer and says Prince played guitar uncredited on Like A Prayer.

facts.text_en: Blondie's official archive says an early demo was called The Disco Song before it became Heart of Glass.
facts.text_fr: Les archives officielles de Blondie indiquent qu'une première démo s'appelait The Disco Song avant de devenir Heart of Glass.
facts.evidence: The official Blondie archive identifies The Disco Song demo as later retitled Heart Of Glass.

facts.text_en: Muse's official site says the song's video was directed by Floria Sigismondi.
facts.text_fr: Le site officiel de Muse indique que le clip du titre a été réalisé par Floria Sigismondi.
facts.evidence: The official Muse page names Supermassive Black Hole and credits video director Floria Sigismondi.
